טיולי העולם העתיק הינו עסק פרטי המנוהל ע: RoniElla Tours is a private business run by guides licensed by Israel's Ministry of Tourism. We organise small-group cultural and educational tours across the ancient world and beyond, with a high standard of local services and, above all, guiding.
חשוב שההדרכה בטיול תהיה משמעותית, מעניינ: We believe guiding should be meaningful, interesting and enjoyable. Before each tour, we revisit and research the sites to stay up to date with changes. This helps us offer our travellers the best experience and make good use of time on the journey.
